rubrics.justification: Description is consistent with an expanded Day 5 blastocyst and broadly matches the provided 3AA grade, with appropriate comments on ICM, TE, and zona thinning; slight overinterpretation of subtle image details keeps it from a perfect score.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, endometrium, sperm parameters, first-cycle status, and lifestyle factors with embryo quality and prognosis.
Overall logic is clear and internally consistent, and the prognosis follows from the favorable factors; minor issues include somewhat confident quantitative claims and a few speculative adjustments.

Recommendations are largely consistent with ASRM/ESHRE principles, especially support for single embryo transfer in a young good-prognosis patient; a few suggestions (e.g., acupuncture/ERA framing) are more optional than guideline-driven.
Provides clear, practical next steps for the current transfer and contingency planning for future cycles, including SET, luteal support, cryopreservation, monitoring, and escalation if unsuccessful.
